title: GPU load rundown — per-cluster weekly trends (week ending 2025-08-03)
content:
Purpose:
Quick weekly export of per-cluster / per-pool GPU utilization to spot unexpected hot/cold pools and suggest short-term adjustments. This is a working sheet — rough numbers pulled from Grafana CSV export and embellished with manual notes.

Scope & notes:
- Window: 2025-07-28 00:00 -> 2025-08-03 23:59 (UTC)
- Resolution: 15m samples aggregated to daily averages and daily p95 utilization where applicable
- Clusters included: us-west-1a, us-east-1b, eu-central-1, ap-southeast-1 (subset of fleets where telemetry is complete)
- Pools: short-infer, long-infer, batch-train, kube-gang, experimental-ops
- GPU types normalized to capacity units (A100-80GB = 1.0, H100-94GB = 1.15 for peak perf) — values shown are utilization % of normalized capacity
- Known gaps: us-east-1b missing earliest day due to agent outage (2025-07-28 02:00-06:00).
